duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.breadcrumb.label: Location
duplicates.info.what: Files of 10 MB or more that are the same, and folders whose whole content is the same
duplicates.info.keep: Each group keeps one copy on the whole volume: in a preferred share, else one that can't be moved, else the oldest. A shared folder's page only filters the list
duplicates.info.excluded: App, system and backup data Reclaim recognizes is never counted: folders starting with @, Hyper Backup and Active Backup data, Surveillance
duplicates.shares.title: Shared folders with duplicates
duplicates.shares.name: Shared folder
duplicates.table.name: Name
duplicates.table.selectRow: Add the copies of {name} to remove to the cleanup list
duplicates.folders.title: Identical folders
duplicates.files.title: Big duplicate files
duplicates.filter.label: Kind
duplicates.scope.title: {scope} · can free {size}
duplicates.scope.overlap: A group with copies in several shared folders counts in each, so the share rows add up to more
duplicates.state.recalculating: Recalculating after a change to preferred shares
duplicates.state.keepFailed: Could not change which copy is kept

duplicates.basket.lead.one: Cleanup list: {count} copy from {groups} frees at least
duplicates.basket.lead.other: Cleanup list: {count} copies from {groups} free at least

duplicates.basket.keepsOne: One copy of each group stays
duplicates.info.junk: Folders are compared without the files systems regenerate: .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, desktop.ini, ._ files, @eaDir. Removing a folder removes those too

duplicates.scope.unchecked.one: {count} copy couldn't be compared by checksums and isn't listed
duplicates.scope.unchecked.other: {count} copies couldn't be compared by checksums and aren't listed

duplicates.analysis.running: Finding duplicates. This can take a few minutes on a large volume
duplicates.analysis.stale: These results are from before the latest scan. Analyze again to update them
duplicates.analysis.noneTitle: Duplicates haven't been looked for on this volume yet
duplicates.analysis.noneBody: Finding them uses the latest scan and reads no file contents. It can take a few minutes on a large volume
duplicates.unavailable.title: No duplicate data for this volume
duplicates.unavailable.body: Duplicates need a scan of the whole Btrfs volume made by this version of Syno Reclaim. Earlier scans don't hold what they need. Scan this volume, then come back

duplicates.expand.inFolders.one: {count} more in identical folders, removed with those folders
duplicates.expand.inFolders.other: {count} more in identical folders, removed with those folders

duplicates.info.partial: Folders whose items are at least 80% the same, by size and at the same places inside, are one row: only the identical items are removed
duplicates.partial.stays: {name} itself and the items that differ, such as .git, stay
duplicates.partial.label: Identical items of {name}
duplicates.list.label: List
duplicates.stays.notShared: Not in a DSM shared folder, stays
duplicates.merged.lead: Ticked folders move to the Recycle Bin. The kept folder stays
duplicates.sheet.lead: Ticked copies move to the Recycle Bin. Untick a copy to keep it too
duplicates.sheet.atLeastOne: Leave at least one copy unticked
duplicates.selectAll.title: Select all
duplicates.selectAll.stopped: Stopped: groups already checked are selected
duplicates.why.nothing: Nothing to move: every other copy is kept or can't be moved
duplicates.sheet.deletes: No Recycle Bin here: removing it deletes it for good
duplicates.block.inFolderDelete: Deleted for good with its identical folder
duplicates.sheet.leadDelete: Ticked copies are deleted for good: this shared folder has no Recycle Bin. Untick a copy to keep it too
duplicates.sheet.leadMixed: Ticked copies move to the Recycle Bin, or are deleted for good where a shared folder has none. Untick a copy to keep it too
duplicates.merged.leadDelete: Ticked folders are deleted for good: their shared folder has no Recycle Bin. The kept folder stays
duplicates.merged.leadMixed: Ticked folders move to the Recycle Bin, or are deleted for good where a shared folder has none. The kept folder stays
